## About the Virtual Academy

The Virtual Academy (Virtuelle Akademie) is a research and development unit at the Bern University of Applied Sciences, focused on the intersection of technology and education.

## Team

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12}
### [Dr. Andrew Ellis](andrew-ellis/)
Researcher specializing in AI applications in educational technology, intelligent tutoring systems, and learning analytics.
